title: Essential metal ions in biology
basic_overview: Biological metal ions provide structural, catalytic, electron-transfer and oxygen-binding functions.

extra_info_content.step_by_step: 1. Identify metal. 2. Identify N/O/S donors. 3. Determine OS. 4. Connect coordination to function.
extra_info_content.factors: Metal availability and redox cycling are tightly controlled in cells.
extra_info_content.kinetics_or_energy: Compare thermodynamic driving force with kinetic barrier when relevant; do not treat a favourable ΔG° as proof of a fast reaction.
